crossRefs.note: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you…
“The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam…
